product.name: Morphik AI-Powered Document Search and Retrieval
product.description: A platform providing AI-driven search, storage, and orchestration for unstructured and multimodal documents, enabling complex document understanding and visual data extraction.

product.name: Morphik Research Agent
product.description: An AI agent that performs deep research by generating insights from thousands of documents using natural language queries and multi-step reasoning.

product.name: Morphik Image Grounding
product.description: A feature that embeds contextual information from images and diagrams to enhance document understanding and search accuracy.

product.name: Morphik Connectors
product.description: Integrations that connect Morphik with enterprise data sources, enabling ingestion and search over native data formats without requiring data transformation.

product.name: Morphik Knowledge Graphs
product.description: A system to build and query knowledge graphs from ingested data, enabling structured connections and enhanced retrieval of information.
